similar.description: Find the documents an index holds that are closest to one of its documents, named by --id and compared with --embedder.

filterable-attributes.description: Attributes usable as filters and facets, comma-separated. Their rule form goes through --data.

non-separator-tokens.description: Characters removed from the default separators, comma-separated, so that they no longer split words.

dictionary.description: Strings parsed as a single term, comma-separated, such as names.

synonyms.description: Words treated as equivalent, as JSON: `{"phone":["iPhone"]}`.
synonyms.name: synonyms

distinct-attribute.description: Field whose value must be unique in the returned documents.

proximity-precision.description: Precision of the proximity ranking rule, `byWord` or `byAttribute`, which indexes faster.
proximity-precision.name: proximity-precision

typo-tolerance.description: Typo tolerance as JSON, for example `{"enabled":false}`.
typo-tolerance.name: typo-tolerance

embedders.description: Embedders as JSON, a map of name to configuration: `{"default":{"source":"openAi"}}`.
embedders.name: embedders

search-cutoff-ms.description: Maximum duration of a search in milliseconds, 1500 when it is null.
search-cutoff-ms.name: search-cutoff-ms

localized-attributes.description: Locales of the attributes, as JSON: `[{"locales":["jpn"],"attributePatterns":["*_ja"]}]`.
localized-attributes.name: localized-attributes

facet-search.description: Whether the facet-search route is enabled on this index, `true` or `false`.
facet-search.name: facet-search

prefix-search.description: When prefix matches are computed, `indexingTime` or `disabled`, which indexes faster.
prefix-search.name: prefix-search

chat.description: Chat settings as JSON, for example `{"description":"A movie database"}`, which the LLM reads.
